1.consolidated_definition: Variante de a la cañona. “Su ascetismo, logrado a la brava, le amargó la vida para siempre…” Edgardo Rodríguez Juliá, Una noche con Iris Chacón, p. 41.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Variant of to the cannon's mouth. "His asceticism, achieved boldly, soured his life forever..." Edgardo Rodríguez Juliá, A Night with Iris Chacón, p. 41.
